label: Bible Study
prompt: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the _____.
verse: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.
note: Young Samuel's track record — every word he spoke for God landed; none fell flat.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the _____ is too great for thee.
verse: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.
note: An angel feeds worn-out Elijah a second time: arise and eat, for the journey is too great for thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he saw them toiling in _____; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
verse: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
note: The disciples were toiling in rowing against a contrary wind when Jesus came by — walking on the sea.

label: Deep Water

verse: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little _____ in our bondage.
verse: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
note: Ezra's prayer counts small mercies: a remnant, a nail in the holy place, and 'a little reviving in our bondage.'
